cues.en: In the last lecture, we worked on the activate user account function.
cues.zh: 上一堂課編寫 activate_user_account。

cues.en: And I think before we proceed, let's work on the to do task that we had added a while ago.
cues.zh: 繼續前，先處理之前加入的待辦工作。

cues.en: So on my VSCode I have this to do extension so I can just click on it.
cues.zh: VS Code 裡我有待辦擴充套件，直接點它，

cues.en: Then it's going to list all the to dos that I have currently.
cues.zh: 就會列出目前所有待辦事項。

cues.en: So I have one in our user auth.
cues.zh: user_auth 裡有一項。

cues.en: And if I click on this it brings me back to this to do which is add, send, login OTP email.
cues.zh: 點開會帶到這個註解：加入寄送登入 OTP 郵件。

cues.en: So what you're going to do is first we're going to create this core service.
cues.zh: 首先建立這個 core 服務。

cues.en: And so we're going to go to backend then app.
cues.zh: 前往 backend/app，

cues.en: Then you're going to go to core, then our services.
cues.zh: 再到 core/services。

cues.en: Currently we have the activation email service.
cues.zh: 目前有啟用郵件服務，

cues.en: Now we're going to add the login OTP service.
cues.zh: 現在加入登入 OTP 服務。

cues.en: So under services create a new file there that's going to be login_otp.py like that.
cues.zh: 在 services 新增 login_otp.py。

cues.en: And so that is under backend then app then core then services and the login OTP service.
cues.zh: 路徑是 backend/app/core/services，再來就是登入 OTP 服務。

cues.en: Then in this file we can say from backend.app.com dot config we're going to import settings.
cues.zh: 從 backend.app.core.config 匯入 settings。

cues.en: Then from backend.app.co dot emails dot base we're going to import the email template.
cues.zh: 從 backend.app.core.emails.base 匯入 EmailTemplate。

cues.en: Then we can create a class which is the login OTP email that's going to subclass the email template.
cues.zh: 建立 LoginOTPEmail，繼承 EmailTemplate。

cues.en: Then for this login OTP email the template name that's going to be login underscore OTP dot HTML.
cues.zh: LoginOTPEmail 的 template_name 是 login_otp.html。

cues.en: Then the template name plain that's going to be login underscore otp dot txt.
cues.zh: template_name_plain 則是 login_otp.txt。

cues.en: Remember we had created these templates before.
cues.zh: 記得，之前已建立這些範本。

cues.en: So if you open the Project Explorer we go to core then emails.
cues.zh: 開啟檔案總管，進入 core/emails，

cues.en: You're going to see under templates we have login underscore db dot HTML and login underscore otp dot txt.
cues.zh: 在 templates 底下有 login_otp.html 與 login_otp.txt。

cues.en: Those are the templates we're using.
cues.zh: 使用的就是這兩個範本。

cues.en: Then the subject that's going to be let's say your login OTP like that.
cues.zh: subject 可以是「你的登入 OTP」。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the actual function to send the login OTP email.
cues.zh: 接著建立實際寄送登入 OTP 郵件的函式。

cues.en: So you can see here async define send underscore login underscore OTP underscore email.
cues.zh: 定義 async def send_login_otp_email。

cues.en: That's going to take in an email of type string.
cues.zh: 接受 str 型別的 email，

cues.en: Then OTP of type string.
cues.zh: 以及 str 型別的 otp。

cues.en: Then this function is going to return none.
cues.zh: 函式傳回 None。

cues.en: Then the context that is going to be sent to the template.
cues.zh: 接著定義要送給範本的 context，

cues.en: That's what we define here.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: So for the templates it's going to have the context of the OTP being the OTP, you can always confirm the context by going to login OTP, HTML, email template.
cues.zh: context 先有 otp，值使用傳入的 otp。可以到 login_otp.html 確認，

cues.en: You're going to see that we need a context of the OTP right there.
cues.zh: 這裡需要 otp 這個情境變數。

cues.en: Then you also need the expiry time which is right there.
cues.zh: 也需要 expiry_time，就在這裡。

cues.en: Then we need the site name and the support email.
cues.zh: 再來是 site_name 與 support_email。

cues.en: So what you can do let's go back to the context.
cues.zh: 回到 context。

cues.en: Then after the OTP we're going to add the expiry time.
cues.zh: otp 後面加入 expiry_time。

cues.en: So you can say expiry underscore time.
cues.zh: 寫 expiry_time。

cues.en: Then I'm getting an error because I don't have a comma after OTP.
cues.zh: 出現錯誤，因為 otp 後面少了逗號。

cues.en: Then for the expiry time we're going to get this from our settings.
cues.zh: expiry_time 從 settings 取得。

cues.en: So you can say settings dot.
cues.zh: 使用 settings，

cues.en: We have one called OTP expiration minutes.
cues.zh: 裡面的 OTP 到期分鐘數設定。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a site name.
cues.zh: 再加入 site_name。

cues.en: And that's going to be settings dot site name.
cues.zh: 值是 settings.SITE_NAME。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the support email.
cues.zh: 接著 support_email，

cues.en: And that's going to be settings dot and Support Email like that.
cues.zh: 值是 settings.SUPPORT_EMAIL。

cues.en: Then we can now send the email by saying await.
cues.zh: 再用 await 寄出郵件。

cues.en: Then you can say login OTP email then dot send email.
cues.zh: 呼叫 LoginOTPEmail.send_email。

cues.en: And the email to is going to be the email.
cues.zh: email_to 使用 email。

cues.en: And then the context that's going to be the context like that.
cues.zh: context 使用剛才的 context。

cues.en: Now that we're done with the login otp.py file, we can go back to our user auth service.
cues.zh: login_otp.py 完成後，回到 UserAuthService。

cues.en: Then let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: At the top we can import our login OTP.
cues.zh: 最上方匯入登入 OTP 服務。

cues.en: As you can see from backend dot app, dot core dot services, then dot login OTP.
cues.zh: 從 backend.app.core.services.login_otp，

cues.en: We're going to import the send login OTP email.
cues.zh: 匯入 send_login_otp_email。

cues.en: Then we're going to go to where our to do statement is.
cues.zh: 再到待辦註解的位置。

cues.en: So let me just go to the to do extension then click on to do.
cues.zh: 點開待辦擴充套件，再點這一項，

cues.en: Then it automatically brings me to where it is.
cues.zh: 就會自動跳到它的位置。

cues.en: It is right here within our Generate and Save OTP.
cues.zh: 就在 generate_and_save_otp 裡。

cues.en: So after this line where we refresh the user object, now we can send the OTP with some retry logic.
cues.zh: refresh 使用者物件之後，加入重試邏輯，寄送 OTP。

cues.en: As you can get rid of this to do statement, then we can say for attempt in range of three.
cues.zh: 移除待辦註解，寫 for attempt in range(3)。

cues.en: So we are setting a maximum of three attempts.
cues.zh: 也就是最多三次嘗試。

cues.en: We're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 加入 try 區塊。

cues.en: Then within the try block we're going to try to send the email.
cues.zh: 在 try 裡嘗試寄信。

cues.en: As you can see await send login OTP email passing in the user's email and the OTP.
cues.zh: 呼叫 await send_login_otp_email，傳入 user.email 與 otp。

cues.en: Then we can add a logger, say logger.info and in F strings we can say OTP send to this user.
cues.zh: 再用 logger.info 記錄，f-string 寫「OTP 已成功寄給使用者」，

cues.en: So passing the user's email successfully.
cues.zh: 傳入使用者郵件。

cues.en: Then we're going to return the OTP.
cues.zh: 接著傳回 OTP。

cues.en: As you can see, return true and the OTP like that.
cues.zh: 也就是 return True, otp。

cues.en: Then, in case of any exceptions, you're going to have the accept block.
cues.zh: 若有例外，加入 except 區塊。

cues.en: So you can say except exception as E, then what you can do is we're going to log the failure by saying logger dot error.
cues.zh: 寫 except Exception as e，再用 logger.error 記錄失敗。

cues.en: And within f strings we can say failed to send OTP email.
cues.zh: f-string 寫「寄送 OTP 郵件失敗」。

cues.en: Then we can add the attempts.
cues.zh: 再加入嘗試次數。

cues.en: So you can say attempt.
cues.zh: 寫「第」，

cues.en: Then passing the attempt plus one then also passing the error.
cues.zh: 傳入 attempt + 1，再傳入錯誤。

cues.en: Then if you're on attempt number two.
cues.zh: 如果 attempt 是 2，

cues.en: So you can say if attempt is equals to two, that is the last attempt failed.
cues.zh: 也就是最後一次嘗試失敗，

cues.en: We're going to clean up the OTP data by saying user dot OTP.
cues.zh: 就清理 OTP 資料，使用 user.otp，

cues.en: That's going to be an empty string.
cues.zh: 設為空字串。

cues.en: Then user dot OTP expiry time we're going to set that to none.
cues.zh: user.otp_expiry_time 設為 None。

cues.en: And then we can say await session dot commit then await session dot refresh passing in the user.
cues.zh: 再 await session.commit()，以及 await session.refresh(user)。

cues.en: Then we're going to return false and an empty string just like that.
cues.zh: 最後傳回 False 與空字串。

cues.en: Then we're going to wait before retry with exponential backoff.
cues.zh: 重試前，使用指數退避等待。

cues.en: Exponential backoff is a technique used to reduce the frequency of requests to a server by increasing the delay between each request.
cues.zh: 指數退避會增加每次請求之間的延遲，降低向伺服器發送請求的頻率。

cues.en: So how do you do that?
cues.zh: 該怎麼做？

cues.en: So you can say right here await async IO, then dot sleep.
cues.zh: 呼叫 await asyncio.sleep。

cues.en: Then in brackets we can say two, then start to attempt like that.
cues.zh: 括號裡傳入 2 ** attempt。

cues.en: So on this line here where we're seeing await async IO sleep.
cues.zh: 這裡的 await asyncio.sleep，

cues.en: Then two raised to the power of the attempt.
cues.zh: 傳入二的 attempt 次方，

cues.en: Here we're basically waiting before we retry with exponential backoff.
cues.zh: 就是在重試前，以指數退避等待。

cues.en: The first retry is going to be two to the power of zero which is one second.
cues.zh: 第一次是 2 的 0 次方，也就是一秒。

cues.en: Then the second retry is going to be two to the power of one which is two two seconds.
cues.zh: 第二次是 2 的 1 次方，也就是兩秒。

cues.en: Then the third retry is going to be two to the power of two which is four seconds.
cues.zh: 第三次是 2 的 2 次方，也就是四秒。

cues.en: And so that is what is going on right here.
cues.zh: 這就是這段程式的作用。

cues.en: Then we can just return false, which is going to be the fallback failure case at the same level as this false statement right there.
cues.zh: 接著在這個 for 迴圈同一層，加上最終失敗的預設回傳。

cues.en: We can just return false and an empty set of strings like that.
cues.zh: 傳回 False 與空字串。

cues.en: And that's it for this end login OTP email functionality within the Generate and Save OTP function.
cues.zh: generate_and_save_otp 裡寄送登入 OTP 的功能就完成了。

cues.en: So please make those changes and that should be it.
cues.zh: 請加入這些修改。

cues.en: In the next lecture we shall still continue with some other functions within the user auth service.
cues.zh: 下一堂課繼續處理 UserAuthService 的其他函式。
